program.def:
def card(work):
    ns = {'w': 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/', 'soap': 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/'}
    _w(work, 'service.wsdl', WSDL)
    root = ET.fromstring(WSDL)
    loc = root.find('.//w:service/w:port/soap:address', ns).get('location')
    tns = root.get('targetNamespace')
    out = work / 'out'
    made = []
    for seq, op in enumerate(root.findall('.//w:binding/w:operation', ns), 1):
        name = op.get('name')
        action = op.find('soap:operation', ns).get('soapAction')
        env = f'<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:t="{tns}">\n  <soap:Body><t:{name}/></soap:Body>\n</soap:Envelope>'
        blocks = {'meta': {'name': name, 'type': 'http', 'seq': str(seq)}, 'post': {'url': loc, 'body': 'xml'}, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'text/xml; charset=utf-8', 'SOAPAction': action}, 'body:xml': env}
        _w(out, f'{name}.bru', dump_bru(blocks))
        made.append(name)
    back = {f.stem: parse_bru(f.read_text()) for f in out.glob('*.bru')}
    return [('one .bru per WSDL operation (3)', sorted(made) == ['Add', 'Ping', 'Subtract'], str(made)), ('SOAPAction header carried per operation', back['Subtract']['headers']['SOAPAction'] == 'urn:calc#Subtract', back['Subtract']['headers']['SOAPAction']), ('endpoint from soap:address', all((b['post']['url'] == 'http://calc.example/soap' for b in back.values())), loc), ('body is a well-formed SOAP envelope naming the op', ET.fromstring(back['Add']['body:xml']).find('.//{urn:calc}Add') is not None, 'parsed')]

'<?xml version="1.0"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/wsdl/soap/"
  xmlns:tns="urn:calc" targetNamespace="urn:calc" name="Calc">
  <portType name="CalcPort">
    <operation name="Add"/><operation name="Subtract"/><operation name="Ping"/>
  </portType>
  <binding name="CalcBinding" type="tns:CalcPort">
    <soap:binding transport="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/http"/>
    <operation name="Add"><soap:operation soapAction="urn:calc#Add"/></operation>
    <operation name="Subtract"><soap:operation soapAction="urn:calc#Subtract"/></operation>
    <operation name="Ping"><soap:operation soapAction="urn:calc#Ping"/></operation>
  </binding>
  <service name="CalcService"><port name="P" binding="tns:CalcBinding"><soap:address location="http://calc.example/soap"/></port></service>
</definitions>'

checks.name: HS256 signature equals the published jwt.io example

program.def:
def card(work):
    tok = jwt_sign({'sub': '1234567890', 'name': 'John Doe', 'iat': 1516239022}, 'your-256-bit-secret')
    known = 'SflKxwRJSMeKKF2QT4fwpMeJf36POk6yJV_adQssw5c'
    h, p, s = tok.split('.')
    tampered = h + '.' + _b64(json.dumps({'sub': '1234567890', 'name': 'Admin', 'iat': 1516239022}, separators=(',', ':')).encode()) + '.' + s
    script = "script:pre-request {\n  const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');\n  req.setHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + jwt.sign({sub: 'u1'}, bru.getEnvVar('secret')));\n}\n"
    _w(work, 'signed.bru', script)
    _w(work, 'token.txt', tok)
    return [('HS256 signature equals the published jwt.io example', s == known, s), ('verify accepts the untouched token', jwt_verify(tok, 'your-256-bit-secret'), 'valid'), ('tampered payload rejected', not jwt_verify(tampered, 'your-256-bit-secret'), 'rejected'), ('wrong secret rejected', not jwt_verify(tok, 'other'), 'rejected')]
